decision: Use the single fixed attribution target R3(20), target_id=1, as the smallest useful source-observation case. It has one direct target array and no PANEL write from R2 into R3. Its history still requires complete R3 direct-writer coverage and carry lineage.

minimal_observer_contract.cross_array_scope: R2 and R1 are downstream of R3 in the PANEL interpolation chain and are not required to prove a first negative mutation of this R3 cell, provided the source/call alias census proves no reverse R2/R1-to-R3 mutation. R4 is upstream through conditional R4→R3 XINT and is a blocking source unless absent or fully authorized by selected stencil+extent evidence.
minimal_observer_contract.first_negative_rule: Only identify an origin if initialization is proven, every R3 mutation/carry/clear affecting the same physical frequency is accounted for in total source order, all before/after values are finite and joined, and the first transition from nonnegative to negative is directly observed. If it is already negative at the first eligible observation, label inherited/unknown, never attribute it to zero.

required_events.gate: Must prove R3(20) lies in the actual initialized extent; source says loop clears 1:MAX3.

capture: each actual J1 producing J3=target index
R3 before/after each baseline and coupling assignment
required_events.gate: Record every hit in exact statement order; include zero-hit call summaries and source RDLIN identity. A zero-hit summary is only valid if invocation and loop bounds were actually observed.

capture: J and source interpolation stencil values
required_events.gate: Capture all destination-R3 XINT invocations, including empty target intervals. Any target stencil without backing and populated/initialized authority is unsupported; do not read or synthesize padding.

capture: each actual R3 destination assignment at the tracked target cell
the exact source operand indices/values and destination before/after
required_events.gate: Do not infer no-write from VFT alone; source-derived index reach must establish whether target is touched.

capture: if nonfinal, old R3(i+150) and new R3(i), plus tail-clear membership
required_events.gate: Final ISTOP==1 skips shift/clear; nonfinal shift/clear must be separately recorded. The target is followed by physical frequency, not a fixed array index across panels.

capture: source-level call/alias inventory for all actual R3 writers in the selected HIRAC1 path
required_events.gate: Any uninstrumented writer or unmatched call count makes first-negative ordering unsupported.

minimal_observer_contract.scope: One target frequency trajectory only; no full R1/R2/R3 dumps and no full ancestry or physical-reference acceptance.
minimal_observer_contract.v14_schema_limit: Current v14 schema captures selected XINT destination-write records and source stencils only when its pre-read guards are satisfied; source extent padding certificate is false/unimplemented, and it does not itself provide complete R3 initialization, RSYM, CNVFNV, panel-shift, or full R4-array coverage. The existing schema alone therefore cannot certify the first negative origin.

source_only_flow_facts.carry: For nonfinal PANEL (ISTOP!=1), NLIM3=151; new R3(i) receives old R3(i+150) for the shifted range, then the source zeroes the upper tail MAX3-NLIM3+2:MAX3. For a target cell at current index 20, the immediate pre-shift source is R3(170), only if runtime MAX3>=170 and the assignment is in range. For a target frequency traced across panels, continue the source-frequency identity through each observed VFT shift; do not assume every panel shifts or infer an absent source cell as zero.
source_only_flow_facts.direct_line_writers: CNVFNV baseline loop writes R3(J3) with J3=J1-J3SHFT; a second coupling loop can write R3(J3) when SPPSP(I)!=0. The target is hit only when J3=the frequency-mapped target index. Capture must preserve source operation order and before/after values for both phases.
source_only_flow_facts.initialization: HIRAC1 computes dynamic MAX3 and clears R3(1:MAX3). The source comment gives a representative MAX3=282, not an execution guarantee. For R3(20), actual membership requires runtime MAX3>=20 and proof that no unobserved prior write occurred.
source_only_flow_facts.interpolation_writers: XINT writes destination R3(I) within runtime N1R3:N2R3. XSECTM can select R3 based on runtime DVX/DVR2/DVR3/DVR4 and ILBLF4; the outer continuum XINT has a separate ICNTNM gate. Capture every invocation including zero-selected-write returns, and every selected write to the target.
source_only_flow_facts.other_R3_mutators: RSYM conditionally modifies its actual array argument when VFT<=0. PANEL reads R3 to add to R2 and does not otherwise directly mutate R3; after output it may shift/clear R3 if ISTOP!=1. PNLINT acts on R1, not R3.
source_only_flow_facts.possible_R4_source: An early XINT can interpolate from R4 into R3 when ILBLF4>=1. The v14 schema does not capture full R4 arrays, and its extent contract does not establish a populated source interval by default. Thus this route must either be source/runtime-proven absent for the target interval or have eligible selected source-stencil values plus a valid initialized/populated extent certificate. Otherwise ancestry remains UNSUPPORTED.
source_only_flow_facts.target_frequency_mapping: At each captured state, record VFT, DVR3, MAX3, target cell index, and the exact source-ordered computed grid frequency. For each nonfinal shift, check source VFT advance and R3 index translation against NLIM1/NLIM3. A matching panel header number alone does not establish ownership.

target.identity_caveat: owner_header=14 is a historical output-header identifier. It is NOT assumed to equal runtime IPANEL, IDATA, a PANEL invocation ordinal, or a source line/chunk number. Bind the physical frequency by recorded source VFT/DVR3 and exact source-order grid evaluation at each frame; if the owning frame/cell cannot be shown, return UNSUPPORTED.

unknown_or_blocking_without_new_target_c: runtime MAX3 and initialized extent for the target trajectory
runtime mapping from historical owner_header 14 to actual source VFT and target cell ownership
full CNVFNV target-hit inventory and all line identities/phase updates before the negative state
all R3-target XINT invocations, including zero-hit calls and conditional source routes
valid initialized/populated extent and selected stencil for any R4-to-R3 route
RSYM target-cell writes and source operands when VFT<=0
every nonfinal/final PANEL shift/clear decision and physical-frequency carry lineage
source-roster closure across actual call arguments/array aliases beyond the OPROP call chain
